name: Litter Genie Plus Cat Litter Waste Disposal Pail System - Odor Locking (Silver / Grey)
description: Selling an incredibly helpful Litter Genie Plus Cat Litter Waste Disposal Pail System in silver/grey [Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/litter-genie-plus-cat-litter-disposal/dp/780782). This is an absolute lifesaver for apartment living or small spaces, eliminating daily trips to the outside trash can by sealing away soiled litter and controlling odors for up to 14 days (for one cat) [Amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/Litter-Genie-Standard-Disposal-Control/dp/B0G3BTZYFS). Features an airtight pull-out sealing handle lever mechanism and a built-in antimicrobial material coat to inhibit bacterial odor growth [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Litter-Genie-Plus-Cat-Litter-Disposal-System-for-Ultimate-Odor-Control-Silver/3922606454). Includes the side-mounted scoop holder pocket and the original cat litter scoop. The unit comes fully pre-assembled, so you can drop it straight into your setup. Please note: This is a pet product that has been actively used in a pet-friendly apartment with a resident cat. The pail and the scoop have been thoroughly washed, deep-bleached, sanitized, and wiped down, though it might retain faint micro-scuffs from normal usage. Does NOT come with an active plastic bag refill cartridge or secondary storage wrap bags; local pickup buyers, please bring a small bag to carry the pail and scoop.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled with side pocket and scoop included. Exceptionally lightweight and compact; it can easily fit onto any standard car backseat floor or trunk spot. Thoroughly sanitized before hand-off. From a cat-friendly apartment.
meta_description: Pre-assembled Litter Genie Plus Cat Litter Disposal Pail for sale. Silver/grey color, includes side holder and original scoop. Deeply sanitized, good condition.
name_zh: Litter Genie Plus 豪华加固版猫砂锁味除臭收纳桶 / 铲屎垃圾桶 (含原装猫砂铲)
description_zh: 低价转让一个超级实用的猫奴救星——Litter Genie Plus 豪华版智能猫砂锁味除臭回收桶（经典银灰色）[Chewy](https://www.chewy.com/litter-genie-plus-cat-litter-disposal/dp/780782)。公寓养猫和多猫家庭的绝对神器，通过内置的高气密性拉杆挡板挡住异味，单猫家庭最长可长达 14 天无需倒垃圾，免去每天倒猫砂去室外大垃圾桶的痛苦 [Amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/Litter-Genie-Standard-Disposal-Control/dp/B0G3BTZYFS)。Plus 版本的塑料内壁含有抗菌材质，除臭效果更强 [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Litter-Genie-Plus-Cat-Litter-Disposal-System-for-Ultimate-Odor-Control-Silver/3922606454)。桶身侧边挂槽和**原装配套的猫砂铲均在**。整机完全预装，免去组装麻烦。**诚实披露**：属于宠物产品，家里养猫。出货前整个收纳桶及猫砂铲已经过**深度浸泡高浓度消毒水洗、刷洗、全面酒精去污除尘**，无任何残留异味，但日常使用导致的边缘轻微摩擦和黑色盖面轻微浮灰在所难免。**请注意：本次转让不含塑料袋滤芯套筒（Refill Bag Cartridge），需要买家在 Amazon 或 Petco 自行购买耗材**。本品不含原厂外包装纸箱或收纳袋，自提的买家朋友直接拎走或放进车后座即可。
